expo-milnor-clarity.evidence: H4: L7 '$\tau=t+i\varTheta$' reuses $\tau$ (the fibre functor) and $\varTheta$ (the contact form) as complex time and its imaginary part; $\xi$ (L4) is a frequency variable here but the Reeb field elsewhere. H8: 'securing base-ring independence where a primitive fourth root of unity exists' is unexplained.
expo-milnor-clarity.notes: Milnor H1-H8 = [2, 1, 1, 0, 1, 2, 1, 1] (T=9/16, fail); weakest: H2, H3, H4, H5, H7, H8. Suggested rewrite (not applied; owner rule 'ask before changing'): '$\mathcal F[f](\omega)=\mathrm{Lap}[f](i\omega)$: the Fourier transform is the Laplace transform on the imaginary axis, which turns the heat equation into the Schrödinger equation ($t\mapsto it$).' Use $\omega$ and $t$ only. Audit doc: docs/audits/2026-10-10-milnor-voice-audit-ch1-ch2.md
